purpose: Re-run of the frozen native-faults plan (C01, C02, C05, C04) on the released adaptive-paper engine, which the gate's 2026-09-24 binding amendment requires before the gate is cited for that engine.
operator: native-fault gate-lane worker session of the 2026-09-25 live-gates workflow (Claude Code subagent), under the project's standing paper authorization; paper endpoint only

evidence_classes.offline_tests_and_hash_checks: measured_local (the native-faults suite is a local synthetic fixture with a fake transport)

tree.note: source-hashes.json has no entry for ../order-contract/order_contract.py; its receipt value equals the tree file and the value bound by the 2026-09-24 18:58Z receipt.

get_checks.method: alpaca-py TradingClient(paper=True) GETs of account, clock, positions and open orders, credentials loaded through runner.credentials(); no request while the harness ran

harness.argv_redacted: <pinned runtime python> blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/native-faults/harness.py run --env-file <lane's private paper env file> --state-root <private dedicated root under ~/.local/state/native-agent-stack/> --out <private receipt path>

lines: trading stream websocket error, restarting  connection: sent 1000 (OK); then received 1000 (OK)
data websocket error, restarting connection: sent 1000 (OK); no close frame received
stderr.source: alpaca-py stream warnings (alpaca/trading/stream.py and alpaca/data/live/websocket.py) logged when a stream socket closed with code 1000; the lines carry no timestamps, and their timing at transport stop is an inference; the receipt records no stop error

harness.receipt_copy: written to private output by --out, copied byte-identical into the tree

ledger_readback.method: read-only sqlite query of the run's private ledger events after the run

limits: One paper run, one host, one paper account; not live-endpoint evidence and no live order.
C05's repeat DELETE was answered 204 again, so a 404 or 422 cancel refusal remains offline-tested only.
C04's 422 is one more paper-endpoint observation of the documented sub-penny body, not a general rule that 422 is definitive.
Ambiguous or in-flight submit faults (timeouts, 429, 5xx, partial fills, restart during a submit) were not exercised.
The trading-gates checker verifies only /status of the receipt; the engine binding above is a separate hash comparison.
privacy: No credential, account id, account fingerprint, balance or host path is recorded here.
